frame.name: sitedrive_0261004, displayed with NASA example Rx(+pi/2)
frame.transformOrder: Rx(+pi/2) * site-frame translation * tileset root transform. Apply asset.transform once; GLB positions are original source positions.

method.raster: Vertical intersections with original finest NASA mesh triangles; highest observed surface; conflicts over 0.2 m masked.
method.reference: Four robust weighted local affine-plane fits at 0.6 m and 1.5 m radius; positive-residual weight scale 0.08 m; full-window observed fraction >=0.55.
method.candidate: Seeds: large-scale positive height >=0.15 m, small-scale height >=0.04 m, 8-connected group of >=4 cells. Grow only through supported residual >=0.075 m and small-scale height >=0.02 m. No semantic rock identification.
method.units: metres; X north, Y up, Z east. Footprints are local metres, not WGS84 GeoJSON.

limitations: 0.10 m is the raster sampling interval, not measurement accuracy.
Ground reference and candidates are model-derived; source stereo and registration errors are unquantified.
Missing and conflicting observations remain masked. An unflagged cell is not verified safe ground.
Candidate footprints are 2.5D raster regions, not instance-segmented watertight rocks.
These local coordinates are separate from the orbital HiRISE mission frame.
